taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA H3 | Microcytic Anemias.

words.clue: Four-subunit protein in erythrocytes containing four haem groups, each with one ferrous iron ion.
Soluble protein that stores iron intracellularly in hepatocytes, macrophages, and enterocytes.
Insoluble degraded iron aggregate appearing as golden-brown granules on bone marrow histology.
Plasma protein that transports the small clinically measured iron pool from absorption sites to erythroid marrow.
Oxygen-binding protein in muscle tissue containing iron for aerobic metabolism.
The unique basolateral iron exporter responsible for all iron egress from enterocytes and macrophages.
Copper-dependent ferroxidase that oxidises ferrous iron for binding to transferrin molecules.
The exclusive site of regulated iron absorption alongside the proximal jejunum.
Reticuloendothelial cell that recycles 25 milligrams of iron daily from senescent erythrocytes.
Intestinal epithelial absorptive cell that takes up non-haem iron via DMT1 transporter.
